latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the ER11 reviser assignment. The full recommendation is in [final.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-02/control/reviser/final.md), with the 30-record [source map](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-02/control/reviser/source-map.json) and [evidence index](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-02/control/reviser/sources/index.md).

The revision addresses the two critic findings: it gates offline assignment on a two-site allocation check, supported by [Microsoft’s sync guidance](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-apps/mobile/resolve-sync-conflicts), and treats fitting-note history as a requirement to verify rather than an assumed immutable feature, consistent with [Dataverse auditing documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/admin/manage-dataverse-auditing).

The source map parsed, evidence links resolved, and all six plan clauses matched verbatim. Product and workflow validations are proposed only; none were run. The native Goal was completed after the artifacts were saved (145,896 tokens; 10m 5s).
